title: Kissed Yeasty Croatian Lamb Stew
description: A comforting and flavorful Croatian dish featuring tender lamb, aromatic spices, and a hint of yeast, all cooked to perfection in a cataplana vessel.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the cataplana vessel over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to brown.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the garam masala, yeast extract, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the chopped carrot and potato, and stir to combine.
Add the lamb broth and tomato paste, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours.
Blanch the stew by quickly submerging the cataplana vessel in a large pot of boiling water, then removing it and letting it cool slightly.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
